quote: It’s like some kind of  Sims simulator. Playing at 30 fps is a rough experience. The morality/reputation mechanic doesn’t fit  GTA. The protagonist lacks charisma. There isn’t a single mission in GTA 6 that’s better than the worst heist in GTA 5.
